owner: dotfiles-runtime daemon run (the hub, sole emitter)

versioning.non_breaking: additive method | signal | topic | optional field stays on org.dotfiles.Events1
versioning.coexistence: Events1 and Events2 may coexist on the bus under distinct interface names during migration

job_interface.served_by: each job process on its own bus-attested unique name; the hub is the only caller and delegates org.dotfiles.Events1.Control(job_id, action) to it
job_interface.delivery: request/response: Events1.Control returns success only on the job ack; unreachable/dead/timed-out -> UnknownJob

delivery.ordering: per-topic monotonic seq (u) within an epoch (u); epoch bumps and seq resets on every hub start
delivery.restart_signal: JobsCleared(epoch) on first start and every restart; consumers also watch NameOwnerChanged on org.dotfiles.Events
delivery.hydration: subscribe-then-read GetTopicState/GetActiveJobs; GetTopicState returns reserved _epoch (u) and _seq (u); drop signals whose (epoch, seq) is not greater than hydrated

capture.state.cadence: on every transition and at least once per second while recording
capture.state.notes: the bar renders the pushed elapsed_seconds (may interpolate locally); it derives no time from a file or shared wall clock

speedtest.state.cadence: on transition: starting at run start, done/error at the single terminal settle (including watchdog abandonment)
speedtest.state.notes: SUPERSEDES speedtest.finished, which had no subscriber, so the widening is observationally free and there is exactly one way to say a speed test happened. state=starting carries only state+trigger; done additionally requires the three measurement doubles and the two context strings; error additionally requires a single-line reason, never a traceback. Exactly one done OR error is emitted per run. The progress bar is INDETERMINATE by construction: speedtest-cli --json returns one blob at the end, so no intermediate fraction exists to publish and any determinate value would be fabricated. trigger names the operation that started the run: scheduled = the interval timer, manual = the panel's Run now, connect = the run-on-connect watcher. ssid and server_name are the CONTEXT of a measurement, carried on done so the notification card can name what it measured; both MAY be empty strings when unavailable (no associated network, a backend that reports no server name) and a consumer MUST then fall back rather than render a blank. ssid is captured when the run STARTS, not when it settles: the run measured the network that was up at the time, and a link that changed mid-run would otherwise be mislabelled

clipboard.update.notes: path is the image file path for image items and empty otherwise; preview is a bounded text excerpt for text-like items and empty for images; never raw binary

clipboard.state.cadence: on every transition (start, pause, resume, stop)
clipboard.state.notes: drives the overlay's incognito indicator and routes Control; job_id is the hub-allocated clipboard job

wallpaper.state.cadence: on transition: applying at set start, visible after the swap, done/error at finish
wallpaper.state.notes: drives the wallpaper selector's progress indicator and LIVE refresh; publish-only, no job lease; wallpaper_hash is empty when the input never validated; visible means pixels swapped while theming is still in flight (busy — UI stays locked until done/error); done/error semantics unchanged; trigger is optional/additive (old publishers stay valid) and names the operation that produced the transition: set = wallpaper set, regenerate = icons regenerate, reconcile = standalone reconcile, reactive = daemon reactive converge
